title: Fleur de Lis Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: With beach-inspired décor and beautiful pickled hardwood floors throughout, Fleur de Lis is a family friendly three-bedroom cottage conveniently located near Central Square and just a short stroll to the acclaimed sugar-white sand beach.
description_expanded: Description66 Seaside Ave1 KING, 1 QUEEN, 1 BUNK, 1 TRUNDLE, 1 SLEEPER SOFA Welcome to Fleur de Lis – A Classic Seaside Retreat Steps from the BeachPerfectly positioned on Seaside Avenue, just three homes from the iconic Seaside Amphitheater and only one block from the beach, Fleur de Lis is a charming coastal cottage that blends timeless Southern style with modern comfort. With generous outdoor living spaces, thoughtful interior design, and a prime walkable location, this home is ideal for families and groups seeking a true Seaside experience.Inviting Outdoor Living & Prime LocationFleur de Lis features expansive front porches on both levels, stretching the length of the home and offering plenty of space to relax and unwind. The first-floor open-air porch includes outdoor dining for six and a comfortable lounge area—perfect for morning coffee or evening gatherings while overlooking picturesque Seaside Avenue. A fully fenced yard with a classic white picket fence creates a safe and welcoming space for children to play, while a private driveway provides parking for two vehicles.At the rear of the home, a spacious porch offers additional storage for beach gear and leads to an outdoor shower and grilling area—ideal for post-beach rinses and casual outdoor meals.Open-Concept Living with Coastal CharmInside, the home features beautiful pickled hardwood floors and thoughtfully curated furnishings that reflect relaxed coastal elegance. The first floor offers an open-concept layout with a recently updated kitchen, a spacious living area, and a dining space designed for gathering. The living room includes a mounted flat-screen TV and ample seating, flowing seamlessly into the dining area, which comfortably seats six. A convenient half bath completes the main level.Comfortable Bedrooms & Flexible Living SpacesUpstairs, three well-appointed bedrooms and a bonus living area create plenty of space for everyone to unwind. The primary king suite features a flat-screen TV, French doors opening onto the screened front porch, and a beautifully updated en-suite bathroom with a double vanity and walk-in shower.The second bedroom offers a plush queen bed, a large flat-screen TV, and direct porch access. The third bedroom is perfect for younger guests, featuring twin bunk beds with an additional trundle to comfortably sleep three.The upstairs bonus living area adds versatility with a queen sleeper sofa—ideal for movie nights, afternoon naps, or additional sleeping space. This area opens onto the screened-in porch, where rocking chairs and lounge seating provide a peaceful spot to enjoy the shaded views of Seaside Avenue.A Thoughtful Seaside EscapeWith its unbeatable location, welcoming design, and family-friendly layout, Fleur de Lis offers the perfect blend of comfort and coastal charm. Whether you’re relaxing on the porch, strolling to the beach, or enjoying time together indoors, this home delivers a memorable Seaside getaway just steps from everything that makes the town special.* 5-night minimum Summer, Spring & Spring Break, 3-night minimum Fall, 2-night minimum Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration.FEATURES 1,825 square feetSeaside Private Residential Beach Access at East Ruskin Pavilion176 yards or a 3-minute walk to the beachPrivate driveway with parking for two vehiclesLocated on Seaside AvenueAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts (court fees apply), 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote with 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 complimentary rental bikes for pickup at Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities providedParking policy: One parking pass issued for one-bedroom cottages; two parking passes for two-bedroom and larger homes. A golf cart is considered a vehicle. Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs require a golf cart permit.No pets allowedSTR23-002007
